summary: V5 end-to-end verified. Backend: 77/77 pytest pass (added 15 tests in test_v5_features.py covering Sublimation products+calc+RBAC, Roll Sticker materials+calc+RBAC, Equipment seeded-by-module + supplies CRUD + admin-only guard, catalog derives from /quotes, new Settings v5 fields). Frontend: admin sees new nav items (Sublimation/Roll Stickers/Price Catalog); sublimation calc (Photo Frame default x25) renders sub-results with 'Paper used' line + Retail & Wholesale; rollsticker (Clear Label x500) renders rs-results with rolls/waste/production minutes + Retail & Wholesale. Save Quote dialog captures customer via [data-testid=quote-customer] and confirms via [data-testid=quote-save-confirm]; Catalog shows 7 rows sorted alphabetically (C,D,M,R,S,T,...), A-Z index buttons filter correctly, search 'roll' -> 1 row, empty state visible when filtered out. Equipment By-Module tab shows all 5 headings (Paper Printing, Laser, Sublimation, Roll Stickers, Large Format) and all 6 seeded machines (Xerox Versant 280, Konica AccurioPress C3080, Glowforge Pro, xTool F2, SureColor F570, Epson ColorWorks C6000A) with True Cost/sqft. Supplies dialog opens, adds a supply, deletes it. Manage Machines tab exposes equipment-add-button + equipment-row/edit/delete. RBAC: reseller sees only wholesale on both new modules with CRUD tabs hidden; /equipment redirects to /. Client (new registration) sees only retail with CRUD tabs hidden; /equipment redirects. English UI throughout.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1292 lines — extract routers (sublimation.py, rollstickers.py, equipment.py, calc/*.py) and models.py; single-file backend is a maintenance risk.

Save-quote confirm testid is 'quote-save-confirm' (not 'save-quote-confirm' as one might expect from the button testid family 'save-quote-button'/'print-quote-button'). Consider aligning to 'save-quote-confirm' or documenting this naming in the PRD.

Catalog.priceOf() has ~8 fallback keys across module summary shapes — safer to normalize server-side by storing a canonical 'price' field on each quote at save time so /catalog does not need to know every module's payload contract.

Sublimation/RollStickers frontend expect res.retail_total/wholesale_total even when the current role is scrubbed to only one side; TotalsBlock likely renders — verify it handles undefined side gracefully (works in current test, but worth an eyeball).
Equipment analyze() serially fetches /calc/equipment/{id} for each machine on load — with 8+ machines this is 8 sequential requests; consider a single /equipment/costs bulk endpoint.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for verified flows (admin full v5 + supplies CRUD + catalog alphabetical/search/A-Z; reseller wholesale-only + hidden CRUD/admin nav; client retail-only + /equipment redirect)
